connector.name: Elasticsearch MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for interacting with Elasticsearch
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package elasticsearch-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cr7258 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ELASTICSEARCH_HOSTS
env.description: Comma-separated list of Elasticsearch hosts (e.g., https://localhost:9200)

env.name: ELASTICSEARCH_API_KEY
env.description: API key for Elasticsearch or Elastic Cloud authentication (recommended)

env.name: ELASTICSEARCH_USERNAME
env.description: Username for basic authentication (alternative to API key)

env.name: ELASTICSEARCH_PASSWORD
env.description: Password for basic authentication (used with ELASTICSEARCH_USERNAME)
